proposals.subject: normaliser

evidence.note: method card methods/normfinder.md: NormFinder, geNorm's best pair and the global mean
geNorm and NormFinder agree on the best pair: ALUsq(Eurogentec) and HPRT1. NormFinder ran with the study's groups (stability value 0.119).

64 genes have values; qPilot offers the global mean from 50 genes. This is qPilot's own default, not a published number: Mestdagh et al. (2009) say the global mean is only valid when a large number of genes is profiled (they profiled 366 to 448) and give no minimum.

check.note: each option is the choice's own and the file has what it needs; which options apply to the analysed experiment is said again when the study is analysed

reasons: qPilot divides each gene by the reference genes chosen for this study; testing NormFinder's and geNorm's best pairs and the global mean shows which conclusions depend on that choice. The reference genes in use stay the same until a person decides otherwise on the card it raises; what a person decided on the other cards is carried to it, unless that choice matters more there.
not offered: geNorm's best pair of reference genes (geNorm's best pair (ALUsq(Eurogentec) and HPRT1) is NormFinder's best pair too)
